title: This Bridge Isn't Collapsing... It Sinks on Purpose
script: This bridge isn't collapsing. It's sinking on purpose! At Greece's Corinth Canal, the bridge drops eight meters under the water, so ships can sail right over it. Then it rises back up, and the cars drive on.

voice.instructions: Energetic, amazed YouTube Shorts narrator. Fast, punchy pace. Hit 'isn't collapsing' and 'on purpose' hard, playful disbelief, smile in the voice.

shots.image_prompt_full: Photorealistic vertical shot from the canal bank, camera looking across the canal at a slight angle, the bridge crossing the frame horizontally from left to right: the low submersible bridge from the reference photo: a flat steel deck with bright yellow painted girder sides lying across the canal at water level, running from the LEFT bank to the RIGHT bank (perpendicular to the canal), resting between square concrete abutments painted with bold black-and-yellow diagonal stripes on each bank; low flat banks with eucalyptus trees, a small white operator booth and street lamps, calm blue-green canal water. The bridge has JUST STARTED SINKING: the yellow girders are now a few centimeters under the surface and water is washing over the whole deck from both sides with white foam. On the near bank a red-and-white traffic barrier is down and two small cars wait behind it. In the canal behind the bridge a white motor yacht waits, facing the camera. Bright Greek summer sunshine, realistic smartphone video look, no text, no watermark.
shots.end_image_prompt_full: Same camera, same banks, abutments, barrier and cars: the bridge deck has COMPLETELY DISAPPEARED deep under the water, only the two black-and-yellow striped concrete abutments stand at the edges with open water between them and a faint yellow shape visible far below the surface. The white motor yacht has moved forward and its bow is now passing exactly between the striped abutments, over the sunken bridge. Bright Greek summer sunshine, realistic smartphone video look, no text, no watermark.
shots.motion_prompt: The whole flat bridge deck sinks straight down into the canal as one piece, the yellow girders disappearing under the water, water closing over it with ripples. Then the white yacht glides forward between the striped abutments over the spot where the bridge was. The abutments, banks and cars stay still. Realistic water physics, the bridge stays intact, no collapse, no explosion.
